title: Verified Generated Snapshot Diff Contract
summary: Deterministically compare two already published Shin output roots after validating each manifest, output declaration, file integrity table, and generated file payload.

release.compatibility: Additive standalone CLI command and result schema.

snapshotOpen.roots: Both existing output roots are canonicalized before lock deduplication. Root and generated snapshot directories must not be symlinks.
snapshotOpen.locks: Shared locks are acquired in canonical path order. Equal roots use one lock. This prevents A-to-B and B-to-A deadlock.
snapshotOpen.publication: An active publication marker rejects comparison as publication-incomplete.
snapshotOpen.integrity: Every declared non-manifest output has exactly one integrity entry and every integrity entry has exactly one declared output. The physical generated tree contains exactly those outputs plus the manifest; every declared regular non-symlink data file is hashed and byte-counted before comparison.
snapshotOpen.outputBoundary: Both snapshots remain locked through validation and diff construction. JSON emission occurs after both locks are released.

identity.snapshotId: FNV-1a-64 identity of the exact manifest bytes.
identity.identical: True only when the exact manifest bytes are equal after both snapshots pass integrity verification.
identity.sameSnapshotId: Reports snapshot identity equality independently from exact-byte equality.
identity.compatible: True when schema_version, generator_version, and profile match; profile_config_hash differences remain visible as metadata changes.

syntacticRecordPolicy.rule: Record deltas compare stable generated ids or bounded structural row identities and exact row hashes.
syntacticRecordPolicy.caveat: A line, anchor, move, or generated-id change may appear as remove plus add. The command does not infer semantic equivalence.

resultSemantics.soft: Without --strict a verified difference returns exit 0 with ok=false.
resultSemantics.strict: With --strict a verified difference returns exit 1 with the same shin.snapshot-diff.v1 document.
resultSemantics.details: One deterministic global detail budget is shared by metadata, row-count, source, source-fact, generated-file, and syntactic-record categories.
resultSemantics.detailsOmitted: The exact number of counted detail events not emitted after the global limit.

verification: source edit, addition, and removal are counted
missing integrity and duplicate output declaration failure
concurrent A-to-B and B-to-A comparisons complete without deadlock
